name: AndroidMic
description: Use your Android phone as a microphone for your PC
readme_summary: AndroidMic allows users to leverage their Android phone as a wireless or wired microphone for their PC. It supports various connection methods like WiFi (TCP/UDP), USB Serial, and USB ADB, and includes features for noise cancellation and audio customization.
key_features: Multiple connection options (WiFi TCP/UDP, USB Serial, USB ADB)
Customizable audio settings (sample rate, channels, bit depth)
primary_use_case: Using an Android phone as a PC microphone
cover_image_prompt: A stylized illustration of an Android phone with a sound wave emanating from its speaker, transforming into a clear, vibrant audio stream that flows through a digital conduit towards a PC. The PC's monitor displays a waveform visualization, indicating the audio input. Subtle glowing lines connect the phone and PC, representing the wireless or USB connection. The scene is clean and modern, with a focus on the seamless transfer of audio. The AndroidMic logo is subtly integrated into the digital conduit. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a bright, tech-inspired color palette.

name: fast-plate-ocr
description: Lightweight & fast OCR models for license plate text recognition.
readme_summary: Fast-plate-ocr provides lightweight and fast OCR models specifically for license plate text recognition. It supports training custom models or using pre-trained ones, with efficient inference capabilities via ONNX Runtime and multiple deep learning backend options.
key_features: User-friendly CLI for training and validation
primary_use_case: Performing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) on cropped license plates for automated license plate recognition (ALPR) systems.
cover_image_prompt: A futuristic, high-speed robotic arm with a glowing scanner head, precisely identifying and extracting the characters from a blurred, fast-moving license plate. The scanner emits a beam of light that isolates the plate's characters, transforming them into clean, digital text that floats upwards. Subtle UI elements showing character recognition confidence scores and the repository name 'fast-plate-ocr' are integrated into the robotic arm's display. The background is a dynamic, abstract representation of data flow and speed, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The overall mood is efficient and precise, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a cool, blue and white color palette.

name: VCamdroid
description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
readme_summary: VCamdroid transforms your Android phone into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows PCs. It utilizes a custom DirectShow filter and supports both wired (ADB) and wireless (Wi-Fi) connections for low-latency video streaming.
key_features: Flexible Connectivity (Wired via ADB, Wireless via Wi-Fi)
Full Camera Control (front/back camera toggle, resolution, flash)
Image Adjustments (rotation, mirroring, brightness, contrast, saturation)
Zero-Config Pairing (USB via ADB, QR code for Wi-Fi)
primary_use_case: Using an Android phone as a virtual webcam on a Windows PC for applications like Zoom, OBS, and Discord.
cover_image_prompt: A split scene: on the left, a vibrant Android phone displaying a clear camera feed, with subtle digital streams flowing out of it. On the right, a Windows PC monitor showing the same camera feed integrated seamlessly into a video call interface (like Zoom or Teams). A stylized, glowing USB cable or Wi-Fi signal connects the phone to the PC. The overall mood is modern and efficient, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The VCamdroid logo is subtly integrated into the phone's screen or the PC's desktop. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear iconography and smooth gradients, emphasizing the seamless connection and transformation of the phone's camera into a PC webcam.

name: prettytable
description: Display tabular data in a visually appealing ASCII table format
readme_summary: PrettyTable is a Python library designed to help developers easily create and display data in visually appealing ASCII tables. It supports adding data row by row, column by column, or all at once, making it a flexible tool for presenting structured information in a readable format within terminal environments.
key_features: Display tabular data in ASCII format
Add rows individually or in bulk
Customizable table appearance (though not detailed in README)
primary_use_case: Presenting structured data in a clean, readable ASCII table format within command-line interfaces or terminal outputs.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman meticulously arranging polished wooden blocks, each representing a piece of data, into a perfectly aligned and visually pleasing table structure. The blocks are labeled with clear headings like 'Name', 'Value', 'Status'. Subtle digital particles flow around the craftsman's hands, hinting at code. In the background, a terminal window displays the finished, elegant ASCII table. The scene is set in a clean workshop with warm, focused lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and precision, showcasing the transformation of raw data into an organized, aesthetic presentation.

name: flowy
description: The minimal javascript library to create flowcharts ✨
readme_summary: Flowy is a minimal JavaScript library designed to simplify the creation of interactive flowcharts and diagrams within web applications. It provides drag-and-drop functionality, automatic snapping, and rearrangement of blocks, making it easy to build tools like automation software or mind mapping applications.
primary_use_case: Enabling developers to easily integrate flowchart functionality into web applications, such as automation software, mind mapping tools, or simple programming platforms.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, friendly robot artisan carefully placing and connecting glowing, modular blocks in a clean, bright workshop. The blocks represent different steps or ideas, and they snap together seamlessly with satisfying visual cues. Some blocks have subtle icons indicating actions or data flow. In the background, a large, transparent screen displays the Flowy logo and a simplified, evolving flowchart structure, hinting at the underlying code. The overall mood is one of effortless creation and organization. The style should be a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a focus on clarity and user-friendliness.

name: make-comics
description: Create full comics with AI in seconds
readme_summary: Make Comics is a web application that leverages advanced AI models to generate full comic books, including stories, characters, and individual panels. It ensures visual coherence by referencing previous pages and maintaining character consistency with uploaded images.
primary_use_case: Automated creation of comic books using AI.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical printing press in a cozy artist's studio. Blank comic book pages are fed into the press, and with a burst of colorful digital energy and glowing AI symbols, fully illustrated comic pages with speech bubbles and narrative text emerge. On a nearby desk, a character sketch is visible, hinting at the AI's ability to maintain character consistency. The overall mood is creative and inspiring, with a touch of futuristic technology. The style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration, emphasizing the transformation of ideas into a complete comic book.
